capabilities: Browse writing patterns by section and purpose
Preview patterns with usage guidance and examples
Insert or replace text at the cursor
Import reference documents and search their passages
Create, edit and export personal templates
disambiguation: Not a debate or argument-mapping tool; it is a library of academic writing patterns and imported source passages for insertion into notes.
extras: Freemium: a free starter library of 60 entries, with a $3/month or $30/year subscription unlocking all 288 bundled entries; free comp licenses for students, educators, contributors, reviewers and hardship cases; 12 consecutive months of subscription makes the library permanent. Desktop only; mobile is unverified. Imported reference documents and personal templates are never gated.
problem: Academic writers lack ready-made phrasing for each part of an essay and must leave their draft to hunt for it.

relations.evidence: They Say / I Say informed the broad writing purposes
the plugin contacts Polar (api.polar.sh) once to activate the key

summary: Sidebar and modal library of academic sentence, paragraph and transition patterns, browsable by section and purpose and inserted into the active note.
